'''Clan Beroya''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]], a conflict waged between the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Among the clan's members were the [[Marriage/Legends|married]] couple, [[Jos Beroya]] and [[Valk Beroya]], who fought closely alongside [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and [[Clan Vizla|her clan]]. The Beroyas trained with Vizla and her people on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], at their complex on [[Tracyn Island]].<ref name="SoR" /> After the Mandalorian leader [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] [[Death/Legends|fell]] in battle with the [[Skytrooper|forces]] of the [[Eternal Empire]], Shae Vizla succeeded him as [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']]. Taking the title of "Mandalore the Avenger," Vizla rallied the Mandalorians to [[war against Zakuul]], and Clan Beroya was among the clans who answered the new ''Mand'alor''{{'s}} call, joining her on [[Darvannis]] for a [[Raid on Darvannis|raid]] on the Empire's [[Darvannis factory|factories]].<ref name="KotFE" />

Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Clan Beroya had established ties with [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud]]. The veteran soldier [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam Beroya]] eventually came to lead Clan Awaud as its [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]], from before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars']] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] to the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After Nam was believed to have died in battle against a group of [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], his [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] daughter [[Vera Beroya/Legends|Vera Beroya]] succeeded him as Clan Awaud's new chieftain.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Beroya was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion for [[BioWare]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|MMOORPG]],<ref name="SoR" /> released [[December 9]], [[2014]].<ref name="Site">{{TORweb|url=shadow-of-revan|text=Shadow of Revan}}</ref> Members of Clan Beroya would again appear in ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} subsequent [[2015]] expansion, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']],<ref name="KotFE" /> and in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="FLT" />

"Beroya" is the Mandalorian word for "Bounty Hunter" in [[Mando'a]].
